My name is An Phan (full Vietnamese name: Phan Thị Thùy An), and I am a PhD student in Computer Science at Florida Atlantic University, advised by [Prof. Xingquan Zhu](https://www.cse.fau.edu/~xqzhu/index.html){target="_blank"}.

My research focuses on applying machine learning, deep learning, and graph neural networks to real-world problems, particularly in healthcare and data-driven systems. I am seeking industry roles in AI/ML engineering and applied research where I can translate research into impactful products.
